name: Data Analyzer: In a deployed environment, a missing API address gives a one-line error and no call
objective: Shows that deployed copies (prod, staging, or any cloud container) never silently fall back to the local address; they stop with a clear message and log it. Run for three environments.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated.

steps.action: Create the analyser with APP_ENV = prod, then staging, then dev inside a container (container name set), with no API address.
steps.expected: No API address is held; the config error contains 'DATA_ANALYZER_API_URL is not set', is a single line, and an 'ui_config_error' log entry is written.
A configuration error naming DATA_ANALYZER_API_URL is raised and no network call is made.

name: Data Analyzer: On a developer machine, the local address default still works
objective: Shows local development is unaffected by the new strict rule.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated.

steps.action: Create the analyser with no deployment settings and run an analysis.
steps.expected: No config error; the call goes to http://localhost:8000/api/v1/analyze.

name: Data Analyzer: In a deployed environment with address and key set, the API is called correctly
objective: Shows a correctly configured deployment calls the right address with the key.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated.

steps.action: Set APP_ENV = prod, an example API address (trailing slash) and key 'k', then run an analysis.
steps.expected: The call goes to <address>/api/v1/analyze (slash handled) with header X-API-Key = k.

name: Data Analyzer: UI waits up to 90 seconds for the API
objective: Shows the wait is long enough for a cold-starting service.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated.

steps.action: Run an analysis and inspect the call's timeout.

name: Data Analyzer: On a first failure the UI retries once and shows a 'starting' notice
objective: Shows that a sleeping service gets one retry and the user is told. Run for four first failures: refused connection, read timeout, HTTP 503, HTTP 504.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated.

steps.action: Make the first call fail in each of the four ways and the second succeed.
steps.expected: Exactly two calls are made, the final result is returned (2 rows), and exactly one notice containing 'Starting the analysis service' is shown.

name: Data Analyzer: Two failures in a row give one clear line and two log entries
objective: Shows the UI gives up after one retry with a plain message and logs both failures.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated.

steps.action: Make both calls fail with 'Connection refused'.
steps.expected: Exactly two calls; error contains 'Could not connect' and 'Retried once', is one line, and 'api_call_failed' is logged twice.

name: Data Analyzer: A 401 (not authorised) reply is not retried
objective: Shows authentication problems fail at once, because retrying cannot fix them.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated.

steps.expected: A runtime error mentioning 'HTTP 401' is raised after exactly one call.

name: Data Analyzer: A failure in the conditional-logic check is shown to the user and logged
objective: Shows that if the rule-checking step breaks, the result carries a visible warning rather than hiding it. Skipped if the logic engine is unavailable.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated. The rule extractor is replaced by one that fails with 'bad branching expression'.

steps.action: Run an analysis with a dictionary having one field.
steps.expected: logic_validation_error contains 'Conditional-logic checks could not run' and 'ValueError', and 'logic_validation_failed' is logged.

name: Data Analyzer: No logic warning is shown when the logic check is fine
objective: Shows no false warning appears normally.
precondition: Web-page component loaded offline with the API call replaced by a canned reply; the waiting time between retries is skipped; deployment settings are cleared and APP_ENV is set to dev unless stated.

steps.action: Run an analysis with no dictionary.

name: Data Analyzer: AI model label on the page comes from configuration
objective: Shows the label follows the configured AI deployment name rather than a fixed one.
precondition: No UI page needed; only the label function is called with environment settings.

steps.action: Set the deployment name to 'gpt-5-nano', then to 'some-other-deployment', and read the label each time.
steps.expected: The label equals each name in turn.

name: Data Analyzer: Page source no longer contains the old fixed 'GPT-4' banner text
objective: A text search of the page's source code, not a behaviour test: it confirms the old wording is gone and the label function is used.
precondition: Source file of the UI page available for reading.

steps.action: Search the UI source for the text 'GPT-4 for intelligent' and for 'llm_model_label()'.
steps.expected: The old text is absent and the label call is present.
